about.title: About GECAL
about.lead: How the group started, what it aims to do and how it works.

background.title: Background
background.body: GECAL began with a group of professionals who met during an air quality course held in Chile. When the course ended, the group decided not to lose touch: to keep communication going between peers who research, monitor and manage air quality in different Latin American countries, and to turn that informal bond into a stable working network.

goal.title: General objective
goal.body: To consolidate a Latin American network of people and institutions working on air quality, in order to keep its members in touch, share technical and scientific knowledge regularly, and strengthen regional collaboration in research, monitoring and environmental management.

specific.title: Specific objectives
items: Keep an up-to-date directory of members, their institutions, areas of work and the tools they use.
Hold regular meetings in which each member presents a paper of interest or their own work and discusses it with the group.
Facilitate the exchange of methods, models (WRF, CHIMERE, CMAQ, MEGAN, among others) and data (satellite, surface monitoring) among members.
Promote joint collaborations in research, publications and projects between institutions in different countries.
Raise the visibility of the group's identity and strengthen it as a regional reference in air quality.

members.title: Who is in the group
members.body: The group brings together {n} people and institutions working on air quality in different countries: {countries}. They work on atmospheric modelling, emission and biogenic emission inventories, monitoring and low-cost sensors, satellite observation, atmospheric chemistry and environmental health, among other areas, using tools such as WRF, CHIMERE, CMAQ, MEGAN, R and Python.
members.france: Developers of the CHIMERE model take part from France.

meetings.title: Regular meetings
meetings.body: Held online: at each meeting a member presents a paper of interest or their own work and discusses it with the rest.
